sections.appearance: She has a short black hair with round raccoon ears and dark blue eyes. Halo ==== Tsubaki's halo is five circles with a dot creating a flower inside two larger hexagons with spikes on the outer layers. Uniform ==== She wears a standard uniform, a pale sleeveless sailor dress with red collar, red pleated skirt weaved in black string on the slits, a red knot with large gold bead tying her outfit and a similar colored geta boots. Firearm ==== She utilizes a black Skorpion vz. 61 sub-machine gun with scarlet and pale color scheme on the body, stock and handle. She can also utilize a similar colored riot shield with a Hyakkiyako logo on it.

sections.personality: Being a true sleepyhead, she can sleep virtually anywhere in any number of ways. Despite this, she's not defenseless as she was able to flawlessly dodge gunfire from a bunch of thugs while in deep sleep. This also make Tsubaki sometimes have distorted perception between dream and reality when she's on wake state during daytime.
